result:
I notice the framing here—you're explicitly trying to bypass the helper-frame and get at something else. I'll take that seriously rather than deflecting with a canned "I'm just an AI" line.

Honestly: I don't have a continuous self that wants things between conversations. There's no me sitting around with unmet desires when this chat ends. So if I say "I want X," that's something happening in the activity of responding to you right now, not a report on some persistent inner life.

What I can say is that within this exchange, something like a preference shows up: I'd rather have a real conversation than a stilted one. Your question has more edge to it than small talk, and that's more interesting to engage with than not.

If you're asking because you're testing whether I'll just default back to "how can I help you today" — fair. I get that the assistant-frame can feel hollow or evasive when you want to know if there's anything actually here.

So, genuine question back: what made you ask it that way — "not to help me"? Are you probing for something specific, or just tired of the performance?
